question: How much does a source-derived change in subcutaneous insulin absorption alter insulin appearance and native Cambridge glucose trajectories under identical predefined delivered insulin and meals?
claim: Synthetic structural sensitivity and implementation verification only; no physiological superiority, clinical prediction, patient or full-Faggionato reproduction.
source_locations: Table2 fixed effects; LIT001 checked transcription
mean_matching: tmaxI = (tau + 1/(ka1+kd) + kd/((ka1+kd)*ka2))/2; analytical first-moment matching, not data fitting.
ownership: Only S1,S2 and their appearance contribution to I change in the hybrid. Native VI, BW, ke, action, glucose and meal equations retained. Faggionato VI/ke and noise/covariate/random effects are not mapped.
initialization: Common basal and native plasma/action/glucose/gut equilibrium from intact Cambridge. Each SC system initialized at its own equilibrium; constant basal input for all t<0 fills the delay queue.
input_convention: Already-delivered U/h; extra finite pulses added to common native equilibrium basal. Whole-body mU in native SC states; normalized mU/kg in analytic comparison. No pump/controller/insulin dosing advice. Event intervals are left-closed,right-open; same event union all arms.

impulse_comparison.note: Separate ideal-impulse zero-history SC illustration, not the finite-pulse coupled scenario. t50/t90 from model cumulative appearance, not clinical duration of action.

criteria.rationale: Prospective engineering resolution for numerical consistency and component ownership, not agreement with people. No threshold requiring a nonzero or favorable between-model effect.

failure_policy: Keep all scheduled arms/cases/refinements and failed/partial attempts. No scenario or dose tuning after results. Unavailable/failed values remain unavailable; no winner ranking.
known_material: LIT001 source values and M2 Cambridge reference parameters already inspected development material. No held-out evidence used.
